Name: Eemie's Animals for BFAV
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Adds Eemie's animal replacers as BFAV animals!
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT HERE, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

A conversion of Eemie's turkeys and birds for [Paritee's Better Farm Animal Variety](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3296).

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4

Go check out the rest of Eemie's animals converted and continued by Vadie (BFAV [Squirrels](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4051)) and [Deer](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3634) (part of New Animals), by Trent!

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/156109690059751424/650047854831861778/Paritees_Better_Farm_Animal_Variety_3.0.6-unofficial.ziphttps://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915[Install BFAV](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/156109690059751424/650047854831861778/Paritees_Better_Farm_Animal_Variety_3.0.6-unofficial.zip)﻿.  Please use the download linked here for now, the official version is not updated yet.

3.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy the folders you want to use into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  You're done; run the game using SMAPI!
